# Example model pricing

Standard rates for the example models, in USD per 1M tokens.

| Model | Input | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| example-flash | $0.35 | $2.50 |
| example-pro | $1.25 | $10.00 |

Prices apply to prompts of up to 200k tokens. Café-region billing is listed
separately. Longer prompts are billed at a higher rate.

Use `<model>` as the placeholder in request paths. Rates are reviewed monthly
and the effective date is shown beside each row on the page.

## Notes

Batch requests cost half of the standard rate. Cached input is billed at a
lower rate. See the limits page for rate limits per tier.
